A REST API has been set up with Node.js and Express 5 using ES modules and a clean modular architecture.

### What Was Created

- **Application & Server**:
  - [`src/server.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/server.js): Server entry point with port listening and graceful shutdown handlers.
  - [`src/app.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/app.js): Configures Express middleware ([`helmet`](https://helmetjs.github.io/), [`cors`](https://github.com/expressjs/cors), [`morgan`](https://github.com/expressjs/morgan), JSON parsing) and mounts routes.
  - [`src/config/index.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/config/index.js): Centralized configuration loader for environment variables.
- **Routing & Controllers**:
  - [`src/routes/index.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/routes/index.js): API router aggregator under `/api/v1`.
  - [`src/routes/health.routes.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/routes/health.routes.js): Health check endpoint (`GET /api/v1/health`).
  - [`src/routes/items.routes.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/routes/items.routes.js): RESTful routes for items.
  - [`src/controllers/items.controller.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/controllers/items.controller.js): CRUD controllers with input validation ([`getItems`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/controllers/items.controller.js#L3-L11), [`getItemById`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/controllers/items.controller.js#L13-L27), [`createItem`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/controllers/items.controller.js#L29-L44), [`updateItem`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/controllers/items.controller.js#L46-L68), [`deleteItem`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/controllers/items.controller.js#L70-L86)).
- **Data & Middleware**:
  - [`src/data/items.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/data/items.js): In-memory store supporting search and filter parameters.
  - [`src/middleware/errorHandler.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/middleware/errorHandler.js): Custom 404 ([`notFoundHandler`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/middleware/errorHandler.js#L3-L8)) and global error ([`errorHandler`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/src/middleware/errorHandler.js#L10-L22)) middleware.
- **Testing & Documentation**:
  - [`tests/api.test.js`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/tests/api.test.js): 14 passing automated tests covering all CRUD operations, filtering, and error handling.
  - [`package.json`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/package.json): Configured with `start`, `dev` (`node --watch`), and `test` scripts.
  - [`README.md`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/my-project/blob/main/README.md): Complete documentation with endpoint tables and example `curl` commands.

---

### Quick Start Commands

```bash
# Start in watch mode for development
npm run dev

# Start in production mode
npm start

# Run automated tests
npm test
```

### Endpoints Overview

| Method | Route | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GET` | `/` | API status and overview |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/health` | Health check & uptime |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/items` | List items (supports `?search=` and `?completed=`) |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/items/:id` | Get item by ID |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/items` | Create new item (`{"title": "..."}`) |
| `PUT` | `/api/v1/items/:id` | Update item |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v1/items/:id` | Delete item |
